newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn 1997 jobless forecast not unrealistic - Jagoda.
newsitem.headline: Bonn 1997 jobless forecast not unrealistic - Jagoda.

text.p: The German Labour Office said on Thursday a government forecast of an average 4.2 million unemployed this year was not unrealistic and predicted the number of people out of work would fall this month.
Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda was speaking at a news conference following the release of February jobless figures which showed seasonally-adjusted unemployment rose 5,000 to 4.316 million.
"The government's forecast of 4.2 million average jobless in 1997 is not unrealistic," Jagoda told reporters.
He added that it was still too soon to make a reliable forecast for the full year, but that he expected the jobless total to fall in March.
A Labour Office official said he expected seasonally-adjusted unemployment to decline by mid-year, but added that the outlook for the building sector was not hopeful.
